about:
Walter Gordon Textiles Inc. was founded in 1960 and operates with sales offices in New York City and a warehouse and distribution center in Rock Hill, South Carolina. The company is a wholesale distributor specializing in woven fabrics, though no details about its founders or ownership structure are publicly disclosed.

The business functions as a wholesale distributor, focusing on woven fabrics. It manages inventory and logistics from its Rock Hill distribution center, handling both domestic and international shipments via truck and ocean freight. No specific facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are provided in available sources.

Walter Gordon Textiles serves wholesale buyers and manufacturers in the textile sector, though specific industry segments or named customers are not detailed in the available information.

The company emphasizes its ability to manage domestic and export shipments via truck and boat as a key operational strength, positioning itself as an industry leader in woven fabric distribution.
